pages.quiz:
FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does 'Madame' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. good evening
   B. Mrs, Madam
   C. Sir, Mr
   D. yes

2. What does 'Ça va ?' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. And you?
   B. How do you spell it?
   C. What is your name?
   D. How are you?

3. What does 'bonsoir' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hello, good day
   B. good evening
   C. Pleased to meet you
   D. no

4. What does 'la grand-mère' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandfather
   B. the girl
   C. the grandmother
   D. the baby

5. What does 'C'est' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the girl
   B. It is, this is
   C. the sister
   D. the family

6. How do you say 'My brother is called Kamau.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est mon frère.
   B. Voici mon grand-père.
   C. J'ai un frère et une sœur.
   D. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.

7. What does 'le salon' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the table
   B. the chair
   C. the TV
   D. the living room

8. Read: Voici ma maison. Il y a une cuisine, un salon et deux chambres. Dans le salon, il y a un canapé et une télé. Question: How many bedrooms are there? (1 mark)
   A. one
   B. two
   C. three
   D. four

9. How do you say 'There is a sofa in the living room.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Mets le livre dans la chambre.
   B. C'est une table.
   C. Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   D. Le livre est sur la table.

10. How do you say 'Today it is Monday.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Le samedi, je joue.
   B. Le dimanche, je me repose.
   C. Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.
   D. Une semaine, sept jours.

11. What does 'un cadeau' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. a party
   B. a present
   C. a song
   D. a balloon

12. Which month is 'décembre'? (1 mark)
   A. October
   B. December
   C. April
   D. February

13. What number is 'seize' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 4
   C. 16
   D. 3

14. How do you say 'They are oranges.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est une banane.
   B. Ce sont des oranges.
   C. J'aime la mangue.
   D. Je mange une mangue.

15. How do you say 'He is tall.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. J'ai deux pieds.
   B. Il est grand.
   C. J'ai un nez.
   D. Touche ton nez !

16. What does 'agréable' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. pleasant
   B. strong
   C. the rain
   D. the cloud

17. How do you say 'There is a storm.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a du soleil.
   B. Il fait chaud.
   C. Il y a du vent.
   D. Il y a un orage.

18. What does 'J'ai un frère et une sœur.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. My brother is called Kamau.
   B. My father is called David.
   C. I have a brother and a sister.
   D. This is my brother.

19. Which little word goes with 'cuisine' (the kitchen)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. l'
   D. la

20. Which little word goes with 'chambre' (the bedroom)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. la
   D. le

21. Which little word goes with 'lit' (the bed)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. les
   C. le
   D. l'

22. How do you say 'the kitchen' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le salon
   B. la télé
   C. la cuisine
   D. le chat

23. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'window'? (1 mark)
   A. fene´tre
   B. fenêtre
   C. fenêre
   D. fenetre

24. How do you say 'the chair' in French? (1 mark)
   A. la chaise
   B. la douche
   C. le chat
   D. le canapé

25. How do you say the month 'October' in French? (1 mark)
   A. juin
   B. octobre
   C. mars
   D. août

26. How do you write the number 6 in French? (1 mark)
   A. quinze
   B. dix-sept
   C. six
   D. quatre

27. How do you write the number 18 in French? (1 mark)
   A. trente et un
   B. dix-huit
   C. douze
   D. deux

28. How do you say 'chips' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les légumes
   B. les fruits
   C. le lait
   D. les frites

29. How do you say 'the leg' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le dos
   B. le genou
   C. la jambe
   D. le ventre

30. How do you say 'the arm' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'épaule
   B. le nez
   C. les cheveux
   D. le bras

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the French words for: hi, bye, no, Sir, Mr (3 marks) (3 marks)

32. Translate into French: 'It is the first of January.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Write a weather dialogue of three lines in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

34. Translate into English: 'Le dimanche, je vais à l'église.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

35. Translate into French: 'I sing and I dance.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Write two instructions in French to tell a friend where to put a book and a bag. (4 marks) (4 marks)

37. Translate into English: 'Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

38. Translate into French: 'There is a sofa in the living room.' (4 marks) (4 marks)

39. Translate into English: 'Je n'aime pas le poisson.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Translate into French: 'I am well, thank you.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

41. Write the French words for: the baby, the child, the mother (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Translate into French: 'There is a storm.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Translate into English: 'Le chat est sous la chaise.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

44. Translate into French: 'Excuse me, where is the school?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

45. Translate into English: 'Ça va bien, merci.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Describe a friend in three sentences in French. (3 marks) (3 marks)

FRENCH — MOCK EXAM #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Mrs, Madam
   Madame means Mrs, Madam.

2. D — How are you?
   Ça va ? means How are you?.

3. B — good evening
   bonsoir means good evening.

4. C — the grandmother
   la grand-mère means the grandmother.

5. B — It is, this is
   C'est means It is, this is.

6. D — Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.
   My brother is called Kamau. in French is Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.

7. D — the living room
   le salon means the living room.

8. B — two
   Deux chambres.

9. C — Il y a un canapé dans le salon.
   There is a sofa in the living room. in French is Il y a un canapé dans le salon.

10. C — Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.
   Today it is Monday. in French is Aujourd'hui, c'est lundi.

11. B — a present
   un cadeau means a present.

12. B — December
   décembre means December.

13. C — 16
   seize means 16.

14. B — Ce sont des oranges.
   They are oranges. in French is Ce sont des oranges.

15. B — Il est grand.
   He is tall. in French is Il est grand.

16. A — pleasant
   agréable means pleasant.

17. D — Il y a un orage.
   There is a storm. in French is Il y a un orage.

18. C — I have a brother and a sister.
   J'ai un frère et une sœur. means I have a brother and a sister.

19. D — la
   cuisine is feminine, so we say la cuisine.

20. C — la
   chambre is feminine, so we say la chambre.

21. C — le
   lit is masculine, so we say le lit.

22. C — la cuisine
   the kitchen in French is la cuisine.

23. B — fenêtre
   The correct spelling is fenêtre, with its accents.

24. A — la chaise
   the chair in French is la chaise.

25. B — octobre
   October in French is octobre.

26. C — six
   6 in French is six.

27. B — dix-huit
   18 in French is dix-huit.

28. D — les frites
   chips in French is les frites.

29. C — la jambe
   the leg in French is la jambe.

30. D — le bras
   the arm in French is le bras.
